summary: Feed s054_single to 10 Gbps NDR is degraded due to tool overload: 1 ms microbursts peak at 12.51 Gbps (125% of port capacity) across 3 intervals, risking packet loss and detection gaps.

findings.root_cause: Single 10 Gbps NDR port is fed bursty aggregated traffic without load balancing. 1 ms bursts reach 12.51 Gbps, exceeding line rate (125% capacity, threshold 80%), causing 3 overloaded intervals. This is classic microburst overload from aggregation to a single tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will drop packets at ingress during bursts. Flow reassembly and detection logic sees incomplete sessions, leading to missed detections, gaps in NDR coverage, and reduced fidelity for full-payload analysis which requires both directions and complete payloads.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic with 5-tuple hashing across 2x10G NDR ports/instances to keep per-port peak under 80% (8 Gbps) and absorb 12.5 Gbps microbursts without drops, preserving complete bidirectional full-payload visibility for NDR.
